context.about:
The Fort Worth Food & Music Festival fills Panther Island with three days of Texas cooking, live music and local makers. Three stages run from noon to late: headliners on the Main Stage every night, local and acoustic acts on the Trinity Stage, and DJs on the waterfront Panther Island Pavilion after dark. Regional chefs cook live in the Chef Demo Kitchen with free tastings, twelve taco trucks line Taco Row and the pitmasters on BBQ Pit Lane start smoking at 4 am.

Entry is free. Food and drink are paid at each stand (cards and phones everywhere, cash at most). Families are welcome: the Kids Zone has games, face painting, a climbing wall and a quiet tent.
context.accessibility: Step-free entrance in the left lane of the main gate. Paved paths link every stage; the Pavilion lawn is grass. Accessible viewing platforms at the Main Stage and Trinity Stage (first come, one companion). Accessible restrooms at Restrooms North. ASL interpreters for Main Stage headliners. The Kids Zone has a quiet tent; ear defenders at First Aid.

amenities.name: First Aid tent
amenities.note: EMTs all day; lost children; sunscreen

faq.a: Yes. Entry is free all three days; food and drinks are paid at each stand.
Overflow Parking on Henderson St is $10 (cash or card), with shuttles to the main gate every 10 minutes. There is no parking on Panther Island itself.
Free shuttles run from Overflow Parking to the main gate every 10 minutes from an hour before the gates open until an hour after the last set.
Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, or small clutches. Backpacks are checked at the gate; diaper bags are fine.
Yes. Re-entry is allowed all day; keep your wristband on.
faq.q: Can I leave and come back?

faq.a: Blankets and low beach chairs are welcome on the Pavilion lawn. No chairs in front of the Main Stage.
faq.q: Can I bring a chair or blanket?

faq.a: Only in the marked smoking area by Restrooms South. Vaping counts as smoking.
Yes, every food and drink stand takes cards and phones. There is an ATM at the Info Booth.
The festival goes on in light rain. In a storm, sets pause and we send an urgent update in the app with where to shelter.
At the Info Booth by the main gate. Lost children go to First Aid.
No. Drones are not allowed anywhere on Panther Island during the festival.
Entry is free, so there is nothing to refund. For a problem with food or a drink, talk to that stand; they handle their own refunds.
Sealed water bottles and empty refillable bottles are fine. No outside food, except baby food and food for medical needs.
faq.q: Can I bring food or water?

faq.a: All ages are welcome. The Craft Beer Garden is 21+ with ID; under-18s need an adult after 9 pm.
Pick a meeting point such as the Info Booth. Lost children are taken to First Aid; tell any staff member in a yellow shirt.
faq.q: What if I get separated from my group?

context.getting_there: Panther Island, Fort Worth, TX 76102. Park at Overflow Parking on Henderson St ($10) and take the free shuttle (every 10 minutes). Rideshare pickup and drop-off is on Main St at 1st St. Trinity Metro buses 1 and 4 stop at Henderson and White Settlement Rd, a 5-minute walk. Bike racks at the main gate.
context.policies: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches or small clutches. Re-entry allowed with a wristband. 21+ with ID in the Craft Beer Garden (wristbands at the gate). No outside alcohol, glass, drones, weapons or pets (service animals welcome). Smoking and vaping only in the marked area.
context.weather_plan: Light rain: everything goes on. Lightning within 8 miles: sets pause and the app sends an urgent update with shelter points. Heat: free water at the Lemonade Stand and First Aid, misting tents by the Main Stage.
